title: Revokyte Telemetry Protocol v1 frame
description: Sender-conformance schema for one telemetry frame (one UDP datagram payload). Encodes sender obligations from docs/PROTOCOL.md section 3; receivers are more tolerant (unknown fields ignored, numeric coercion). Every field is optional: omitting a field means 'channel not provided'. Fields marked 'omit, never null' reject explicit null. License: CC0-1.0 (public domain dedication) - see LICENSES/CC0-1.0.txt.

v.description: Protocol version. Absent means 1. For v1 conformance, if present it must be 1.

received_time.description: Receiver-owned arrival stamp; senders may include it, receivers ignore the wire value (PROTOCOL.md 3.4).

car_speed.description: Ground speed in m/s, non-negative even when reversing.

current_gear.description: 0 = reverse, -1 = neutral, 1.. = forward. Null is not a valid gear.

steering.description: Steering input, sender-defined calibration. Effectively reserved.

gas_level.description: Remaining fuel in sender-defined fuel units (only the ratio to gas_capacity is portable).

gas_capacity.description: Fuel tank capacity in the same sender-defined units; 0 = no fuel model (disables fuel gauges).

lap_count.description: Lap counter as the game defines it; null = not in a lap-counted session.

laps_in_race.description: Total race laps; null = not applicable.

best_lap_time.description: Session-best lap time in milliseconds; null = none yet.

last_lap_time.description: Previous lap time in milliseconds; null = none yet.

current_lap_time.description: Running current-lap clock in milliseconds; null = no timed lap active.

flags.description: Boolean status flags. Omit, never null.

rpm_alert.description: Shift-warning band (min = warning RPM, max = limiter RPM). Omit, never null; omit when the source has no meaningful band.

wheels.description: Four wheel corners. Omit, never null.

position.description: World position in meters, game-specific frame (x/z horizontal, y vertical). Nullable.

gear_ratios.description: Drivetrain ratios for forward gears 1..N, index 0 = 1st gear; consumed by the receiver's shift-point calculation. Relative values are what matters, so gearbox-only or overall (x final drive) ratios are equally valid. Omit, never null; omit unknown ratios rather than sending 0 (PROTOCOL.md 3.5.5).

engine.description: Engine curve summary for the shift-point calculation (PROTOCOL.md 3.5.5). Omit, never null; redline travels as rpm_alert.max, not here.

native_delta_ms.description: Source-computed delta to the reference lap, signed milliseconds, negative = ahead. Nullable.

track_name.description: Source-provided track name, free text. Nullable.

suspension_height.description: Normalized suspension compression; senders must clamp to [0, 1] - out of range invalidates the whole frame at the receiver.

rps.description: Wheel rotation in revolutions per second (not rad/s); signed.

ground_speed.description: Contact-patch speed (omega x r) in m/s.

temperature.description: Tyre temperature in degrees C; default 20.
